'''Huloon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Huloon system/Legends|Huloon system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' near the center of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. A part of Hutt Space, it was formerly the home to a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Species/Legends|species]] also called [[Huloon/Legends|Huloons]] before it was depopulated by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and turned into a nature preserve. After they had lost their home, small populations of Huloons resided on many worlds outside the ''Bootana Hutta'' and yearned to return. However, those desperate for a glimpse of their stolen home would often suffer ridicule and torment at the hands of the Hutts.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huloon was first introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2009]].<ref name="TEA" />
